note: Feedback request after rejection. Could be status_check; labeled other.

subject: Accessibility
body: I'm hard of hearing. Would it be possible to have live captions or a written format for the interview?
URGENT please call me back

body: Please find attached 5 pre-screened profiles for your backend role. Our fee is 18% of first-year salary.

subject: Re: Offer
body: Can we revisit the base? Another company came in 15% higher. I'd still prefer you if we can get closer.

subject: Equipment
body: Ahead of my first day, will I get a laptop shipped or should I use my own?

subject: Moving my interview again, sorry
body: I know we already moved it once but my kid is sick. I'm so sorry. Is there anything later this week? If not I understand if you need to move on.
note: Has a soft withdrawal at the end.

subject: Background check
body: The background check company is asking for my old employer's address, which closed in 2019. What should I put?

body: The contract says start on the 3rd but I'll still be serving notice. Can we push it two weeks?

subject: Not continuing
